name: de-capital-gains
description: German tax on private investment income and gains for a resident individual, tax year 2026. Covers the 25% flat tax (Abgeltungsteuer) with the 5.5% solidarity surcharge and the church-tax formula, bank withholding (Kapitalertragsteuer), the Sparer-Pauschbetrag of EUR 1,000 or EUR 2,000, the share-loss pot and the general pot, loss certificates, funds and ETFs (Teilfreistellung, Vorabpauschale, Basiszins), large holdings of 1% or more under § 17 with the partial-income method, private sales under § 23 (one-year and ten-year rules, the EUR 1,000 Freigrenze), the Günstigerprüfung and Anlage KAP. Trigger on: Abgeltungsteuer, Kapitalertragsteuer, Sparer-Pauschbetrag, Freistellungsauftrag, Verlustbescheinigung, Teilfreistellung, Vorabpauschale, Spekulationsfrist, sell shares Germany, German capital gains.
